description.value: Tuckkwiowhum Heritage Interpretive Village is operated by the Boston Bar First Nations and interprets the history and culture of the Indigenous peoples of the Fraser Canyon region. Located along the historic Hicks Road corridor near Boston Bar, it offers visitors an immersive look at traditional village life and heritage. For a touring cyclist passing through the rugged Fraser Canyon, it represents a rare opportunity to engage with the deep Indigenous history of this corridor.
